posts.title: Which of my hosts need the nginx security update? Asking SamDrucker
posts.description: Today brought a security update for nginx: nginx-1.30.7,3. That raises two questions every time: which of my hosts run nginx, and which of them need the update? I have a lot of hosts. Until today, answering meant logging into each one, or a loop of ssh host pkg info nginx. Now I have a better way. posts.description: I’ve heard about and thought about proxies for pkg servers for some time. Perhaps years, but definitely months. I never took action until I saw this commit in today’s FreshPorts new ports email: ports-mgmt/git-proxy Caching proxy for package registries, including FreeBSD pkg Today.
